items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And Big Green is in there, and he's drunk, and he'd lost his weight, and he said ain't nobody would hire him after Fletcher

ctx.x: No. That was where I saw Jabbo. All these people was in a gin mill on Seventh Avenue down in a basement, and I'm in there. And Big Green is in there, and he's drunk, and he'd lost his weight, and he said ain't nobody would hire him after Fletcher, and Chick Webb hired him for a while but he couldn't depend on him...
Big Green the trombone player, yeah..
